title.zh: CKBFS V2 约束（witness 文件存储）

subtitle.zh: 来源：code-monad/ckbfs @db973a8 contracts/ckbfs/src/entry.rs + contracts/ckb-adler32（mode 1）　·　data1 0x31e6…8d3a（主网 + 测试网）
subtitle.en: Source: code-monad/ckbfs @db973a8 contracts/ckbfs/src/entry.rs + contracts/ckb-adler32 (mode 1)　·　data1 0x31e6…8d3a (mainnet + testnet)

outputs.label: CKBFS cell

role.zh: 可选：校验器 data1 code hash

cons.en: defaults to the built-in ckb-adler32 hash

role.zh: 内容所在 witness 序号

cons.en: = adler32(witness[6..] of each index, in order)

cons.zh: 创建时必须为空（见说明）
cons.en: must be empty on create (see notes)

cond.zh: 同一 tx 中该 type 的输出 ≤ 1
cond.en: ≤ 1 output with this type in the tx

cond.zh: ≥ 32 字节；args[0..32] 按 type_id 规则
cond.en: ≥ 32 bytes; args[0..32] by the type_id rule

cond.zh: 合法 molecule；indexes 非空；backlinks 为空
cond.en: valid molecule; indexes non-empty; backlinks empty

cond.zh: 含 data hash = 校验器 code hash 的 cell（解码器不检查）
cond.en: contains a cell whose data hash = the hasher code hash (not checked by the decoder)

cond.zh: exec ckb-adler32 mode 1：adler32(witnesses[indexes][6..]) = data.checksum；witness 缺失或 < 6 字节时 panic
cond.en: exec ckb-adler32 mode 1: adler32(witnesses[indexes][6..]) = data.checksum; a missing or < 6-byte witness panics

inputs.label: CKBFS cell
inputs.body: Cell{ type: CKBFS_V2, data: { indexes: I, checksum: c0, content_type, filename, backlinks: B } }

outputs.label: CKBFS cell

cond.zh: 若输入 indexes 非空或输入 backlinks > 1：输出 backlinks 恰多 1 个；最后一个的 tx_hash = 输入 out_point.tx_hash 或 indexes = 输入 indexes
cond.en: if input indexes is non-empty or input backlinks > 1: output has exactly one more backlink; the last one has tx_hash = input out_point.tx_hash or indexes = input indexes

cond.zh: 输入 backlinks 原样作为输出前缀
cond.en: input backlinks kept unchanged as the output prefix

cond.zh: 从 c0 恢复 Adler-32 状态，继续累加 witnesses[I′][6..]，结果 = c1
cond.en: resume Adler-32 from c0 over witnesses[I′][6..]; result = c1

inputs.label: CKBFS cell
inputs.body: Cell{ lock: A, type: CKBFS_V2, data: { checksum: c0, backlinks: B, … } }

outputs.label: CKBFS cell
outputs.body:
Cell{ lock: {{B′}}, type: 同上 / same,
  data: { indexes: {{[]}}, checksum: c0, content_type, filename, backlinks: {{…}} } }

cond.zh: 输出 indexes 为空即视为转移，checksum 不变
cond.en: empty output indexes means transfer; checksum unchanged

cond.zh: 输入无 backlink：输出恰 1 个，且 tx_hash = 输入 out_point.tx_hash；否则 backlinks 完全相同
cond.en: input has no backlink: output has exactly 1 with tx_hash = input out_point.tx_hash; otherwise backlinks identical

cond.zh: 有输入无输出 → 失败

notes.zh: 版本：README 把 0x31e6…8d3a 标为 "Version 20241025.db973a8e8032"，即提交 db973a8（tag v2/v2.0 = 88297de 只改 README）。该提交的 hash.rs 固定 ckb-adler32 = 0x2138…536f，与链上 V2 部署交易同一 dep_group 中的 adler32 cell 一致。未做可复现构建。
notes.en: Version: the README labels 0x31e6…8d3a "Version 20241025.db973a8e8032", i.e. commit db973a8 (tags v2/v2.0 = 88297de only edit the README). That commit's hash.rs pins ckb-adler32 = 0x2138…536f, which matches the adler32 cell in the same on-chain dep_group. No reproducible build was attempted.

notes.zh: 数据结构来自 crates.io ckbfs-types 0.2.1（schemas/ckbfs.mol），不是仓库 RFC.md（那时 RFC 仍是 V1 的 index: Uint32Opt）。
notes.en: The data layout comes from crates.io ckbfs-types 0.2.1 (schemas/ckbfs.mol), not the repo RFC.md (which still showed V1's index: Uint32Opt at that commit).

notes.zh: 校验通过 exec_cell 跳转到 ckb-adler32，进程被替换，所以 checksum 不符时退出码是 adler32 的 -101（ValidateFailure），104 只在 exec 本身失败时出现。
notes.en: Checksum validation exec_cell-s into ckb-adler32, which replaces the process, so a wrong checksum exits with adler32's -101 (ValidateFailure); 104 only appears when exec itself fails.

notes.zh: 按源码原样：创建时若 backlinks 非空，查找引用 cell 用 32 字节 code_hash 与整个序列化 Script 比较，永远不相等 → 101；且读取 cell_dep 用的是输出序号而不是找到的位置。
notes.en: As written: on create with non-empty backlinks, the reference-cell search compares a 32-byte code_hash with the whole serialized Script, which never matches → 101; it would also read the cell_dep at the output index rather than the found position.

notes.zh: 只看第一个带此 type 的输入；witness 头 "CKBFS" ‖ 0x00 不被检查，只是跳过 6 字节。
notes.en: Only the first input with this type is considered; the witness header "CKBFS" ‖ 0x00 is not checked, just skipped (6 bytes).
